source_basis: Local English text and inventory only; no licensed media, embeddings or external requests.

confirmed_reuse.meaning: References/specifications can share authoring. Neither identical text nor an alias proves a production clip is ready; unresolved mechanics must first be resolved.

base_clip_forecast.status: conditional seed/generator task bracket; not approved or measured final clip count
assumptions: One seed/generator demonstration per family/pose/category (lower) or additionally resistance/scene bases (upper); one individually reviewed seed per unclassified exercise.

The shared generator accepts explicit per-ID motion subtype, contacts, grip, side order, amplitude and timing. Unsupported subtypes split the generator; separate final clips can still be baked for every ID.

Every source difference is reviewed; no source gap permits invented mechanics. The bracket assumes parameter/controller implementation and may rise toward 5,630 separately resolved specifications if it fails.
This counts repeated scaffold/seed authoring tasks only, excluding per-ID profiles, review, support solving, apparatus construction, rendering, and exports.
